title: Sustainable biogas production through anaerobic co-digestion of Ulva lactuca (Chlorophyta) and cow manure: a kinetic and process optimization study
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00298B, Paper

Obie Farobie, Veni Anggita Sari, Edy Hartulistiyoso, Widya Fatriasari, Asep Bayu Dani Nandiyanto, Apip Amrullah, Lusi Ernawati, Misbahuddin
This study explored the anaerobic co-digestion of Ulva lactuca and cow manure to enhance methane yield. A 2 : 1 ratio produced 325.75 mL per g VS methane. The modified Gompertz model best fit the kinetics.
